summary: Fix round for the clients lane, covering the 15 review findings. A previous session in this round fixed F1-F14 in code. This session confirmed each finding against a private ES 9.5.5, completed F10 and F15, refined F1 and added regression fixtures. F1 refinement: ES 9.5.5 reindex reads the shards one after the other, while delete_by_query and update_by_query interleave them by doc id. F10: function_score over a boosting that rewrites to match_none. F15: scaled_float with numeric_type long or date; exists on a root flattened field. Fresh seed 23 surfaced terminate_after bugs, also fixed: Elasticsearch counts only hits that pass post_filter and min_score, and reports terminated_early:false on count-only requests. Further fixes: completion-suggest shard failures (partial results, all shards failed, fetch-phase stripping); _count and _explain wrapping x_content query errors as a parsing_exception; no caused_by on 'Partial shards failure'; track_total_hits printed as an int in profile.request. 5 new hand-written fixtures bring the total to 69. Replay, seed 1, both YAML suites and the client matrix are green.
public_api: search-index: `TerminateAfter::counting(self, &Searcher, min_score: Option<f32>, post_filter: Option<&QueryRef>) -> Result<TerminateAfter<C>>` makes only hits that pass min_score and the post filter count toward terminate_after; uncounted matches still reach the inner collector. Documented in contracts.md, which now also lists `Shard::note_realtime_get` (added earlier this round). search-es internal changes: `search::suggest::run(.., failed: &mut Vec<ShardFailure>)`, where `ShardFailure = (usize, EsError, bool /*fetch*/)`; `api::by_query::scan(.., by_shard: bool)`; `search::sort::ValueFormat::ScaledLong(f64)`; `search::query::rewrites_to` is now pub(crate) and covers Boosting and FunctionScore.
done: F1: by_query.rs Scanner now merges by key: delete_by_query and update_by_query interleave shards by (doc, shard), reindex reads shard by shard (verified on 2 and 3 shards on ES 9.5.5). Added unit test merge_keys_interleave_or_go_shard_by_shard and fixture by-query-max-docs-merges-shards-by-doc

F2/F3: fixture inner-hits-sort-collapse-and-runtime-mappings: nested inner_hits sorts with missing, mode, _score and sum/avg; collapse plus nested inner_hits; collapse inner_hits with runtime_mappings (long and keyword)

F4/F5/F7/F10/F14: fixture query-string-edges-conjunction-scoring-boosting-none: 19 query strings, conjunctions with a function_score lead, boosting and function_score over match_none, the 'exception' type including allow_expensive_queries=false. Also fixed function_score whose query rewrites to match_none through boosting (query.rs rewrites_to, extra.rs)
F6: confirmed the harness sorts only ' | ' operands and runs of same-value field clauses (unit test disjunctions_compare_sorted)

F15(5): scaled_float with numeric_type long or date prints and merges truncated longs, and search_after bounds are mapped exactly (sort.rs ValueFormat::ScaledLong, scaled_long_after, unit test numeric_type_long_truncates_scaled_floats). F15(4): exists on a root flattened field prints FieldExistsQuery [field=x._keyed] and does not rewrite (query.rs). F15(1)-(3) and the short range already matched; they are pinned in the fixture

Completion suggest shard failures (suggest.rs, mod.rs): a field that is not a completion field, or is unmapped, fails that shard. Options are fetched after the merge; a failed fetch keeps text and score only. Partial results, 'all shards failed' and 'Partial shards failure' with phase fetch now match ES

terminate_after: search-index TerminateAfter::counting plus FilterBits; search-es run_collect uses it. Unit test terminate_after_counts_filtered_hits_only and fixture terminate-after-counts-post-filtered-min-score-hits
Count-only requests (size 0, accurate total hits, no aggs/suggest/rank/knn/profile) print terminated_early:false, following CountOnlyQueryPhaseResultConsumer (mod.rs)

_count and _explain: an x_content_parse_exception from the query becomes parsing_exception 'Failed to parse' at the same location (mod.rs query_content_error). 'Partial shards failure' has no top-level caused_by (all_shards_failed). profile.request track_total_hits prints 2147483647 / -1 (profile.rs)
Docs: compatibility.md (differential rows, review-round fixed and open lists) and contracts.md (TerminateAfter::counting, note_realtime_get)
remaining: top_hits sort on unsigned_long: Elasticsearch prints the raw sortable long (u ^ 2^63) and missing values as Long extremes. Fixing it needs a raw-unsigned flag on search-aggs HitSort::Field (DocSort NumKind::Long), with numeric_type double kept as doubles; top_metrics' unsigned sort format and missing order differ too

Empty clauses inside aggregation filters (filters, adjacency_matrix): Elasticsearch fails at parse time with the x_content_parse_exception chain ('[adjacency_matrix] failed to parse field [filters]' > '[filters] failed to parse field [a]' > bool > IAE). roll parses agg filter queries per shard and fails every shard instead
terms aggregation under terminate_after with a match_all query: Elasticsearch's filter-by-filter terms counts whole segments and ignores termination (doc_count 6/6 where per-doc collection gives 4/3)

numeric_type long on double/float/scaled_float: a shard still picks its top hits by the untruncated value, so ties at the page boundary can pick a different doc than Elasticsearch (truncation would have to happen inside search-index's comparator)

Open from fresh seed 23 after the fixes (13 signatures): _explain/_validate descriptions (ids rewritten to match_none, combined_fields on unmapped fields as 'unmapped fields []', BinaryDocValuesRangeQuery, CaseInsensitiveWildcardQuery, span_field_masking printing mask()); _msearch shard failure order across indices; a highlight on a must_not-only clause; DFS score with several indices; delete_by_query error col; sort on a completion field reports 'Fielddata is not supported on field [c] of type [completion]'

Older open items, still listed in compatibility.md: rescore queries' nested inner_hits, fields with stored_fields, DFS with knn and aggs, min_score with a filter agg, more_like_this on text1, composite histogram after_key over several indices, and the term suggester for short misspellings
tests: Differential (search-server tests/differential.rs): 10/10 pass, including replay_cases over 69 fixtures. random_workloads seed 1 (60 cases, CI): 99.7%, known differences only. Fresh seed 23 (150 cases): 99.1% with 37 new signatures before the round; 99.5% with 15 new after it; 2 of those 15 (terminate_after) are now fixed. search-es lib: 453 passed. search-index: all test binaries green, including the new collectors::terminate_after_counts_filtered_hits_only. search-server: all green (lib 48, crash 2, differential 10, durability 19, fairness 2, fencing 7, http 21, persist 13, store 1). YAML ES 9.5.5: 3905 tests, 3809 passed, 1 failed (210_knn_search_profile, already in the baseline), 95 skipped, 0 regressions. OpenSearch 3.9.0: 1455/1506 passed, 0 failed, 0 regressions. Client matrix: 11/11 (searchkick 540 runs, 0 failures). Clippy -D warnings is clean on search-index and search-server (--all-targets) and on the search-es lib. search-es --all-targets fails on one byte_char_slices lint at api/bulk.rs:575, in another lane's in-progress test code, which I did not touch.
notes_for_others: perf/bulk owner: clippy --all-targets on search-es fails on api/bulk.rs:575 (byte_char_slices: use *b"]" instead of [b']']), in test code

compat-es: _reindex reads source shards one after the other (shard 0 first), unlike delete_by_query and update_by_query, which interleave by doc id (verified on ES 9.5.5 with max_docs on 2 and 3 shards). by_query::scan has a by_shard flag

compat-es/perf: terminate_after now counts only hits that pass post_filter and min_score (TerminateAfter::counting); other matches still reach aggs until the limit is passed. The cheap-count shortcuts already skip post_filter and min_score

compat-es: count-only requests (size 0, track_total_hits true/int max or rest_total_hits_as_int, no aggs/suggest/rank/knn/profile) always print terminated_early (false unless a shard terminated). This applies to the ES dialect only

compat-es: completion suggest errors are now per-shard failures returned through suggest::run's failed vec; the coordinator turns them into partial results or 'all shards failed' / 'Partial shards failure' (phase fetch when the fetch failed on a multi-shard search)
aggs: top_hits on unsigned_long should render raw sortable longs (see remaining). Elasticsearch's terms agg under terminate_after with a match_all query counts whole segments
Everyone: all_shards_failed no longer adds a top-level caused_by for 'Partial shards failure' in the ES dialect, as Elasticsearch does
